# Transcriber's notes {.unnumbered}

In this edition, the symbol $\partof$ is used as a typographical approximation for the author's original *part* of relational symbol [(@sec-systems-of-elements, par. 3)](2_01_systems-of-elements.qmd#par-3), which should not be confused with the numerical digit $3$. Correspondingly, the symbol $\wholeof$ serves as its inverse (*whole* of [(@sec-systems-of-elements, par. 3)](2_01_systems-of-elements.qmd#par-3)), representing the converse relationship such that $S \wholeof A$ is logically equivalent to $A \partof S$.

Also the following typographical errors have been corrected:

[@sec-transformation-of-a-system-in-itself, par. 42](2_04_transformation-of-a-system-in-itself.qmd#par-42) "$A' \partof B$, $B' \partof B$, $C' \partof C$" in original, amended to "$A' \partof A$" etc.

[@sec-definition-of-a-transformation-of-the-number-series-by-induction, par. 125](2_09_definition-of-a-transformation-of-the-number-series-by-induction.qmd#par-125) "the transformation $\psi$, is therefore completely defined" in original, amended to "$\psi_1$".
